We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified integrated amusement destination with an amusement cum water park, a snow park, an integrated resort and an upcoming aerial cable car project near Athirappilly waterfalls in Thrissur, Kerala (“Athirappilly Theme Park”). We are one of the renowned and established players in the region and set to become the first amusement park in the region to offer a cable car for tourist (Source: Care Report). Spread across approximately 17.38 acres, our park integrates an amusement cum water park, a snow park, and resort facilities, offering a comprehensive entertainment destination for families, students, tourists, corporate groups, and institutional visitors. We also own and operate snow park at Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, with a total area of 5,183 square feet (“Jamshedpur Snow Park”) and are setting up a new snow park and family entertainment center at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh with total area of more than 11,000 square feet (“Lucknow Snow Park and FEC”). Located in midst of lush green forest area of western ghats in Thrissur district of Kerala and nearby scenic Athirappilly waterfalls, largest waterfall in Kerala and Vazhachal waterfalls, our Athirappilly Theme Park collectively features a wide array of 41 low to high thrill rides, 3 restaurants (including 1 restaurant at Athirappilly waterfalls) and resort with 8 well-appointed room as of March 31, 2026, making us a one-stop entertainment destination. Our Athirappilly Theme Park offers various water-based rides and amusement rides. In April 2023, we launched several new water rides, enhancing the appeal of our offering for both first-time and repeat visitors. Our Athirappilly Theme Park has been visited by over 16.09 lakhs visitors in last three financial years. A significant addition in Athirappilly Theme Park was the introduction of Kerala’s first indoor snow park under the brand name “Snow Storm” in the year 2017, spread over approximately 10,000 square feet and maintained at -10°C (Source: Care Report). Snow Storm is a standalone attraction of our Athirappilly Theme Park with independent ticketing and features various snow-based experiences which are otherwise not naturally available in Kerala. In October 2025, we have expanded our geographical footprint, through our subsidiary “Snowstorm Parks Private Limited”, by launching a new snow park at P & M Hi-Tech city center mall in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand and are also in the process of setting up a new snow park and family entertainment center at Omaxe Hazratganj Mall in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh which we expect to operationalize by fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027. In addition to amusement cum water park and snow park at Athirappilly Theme Park, we also operate 8 wellappointed rooms under the brand “Silver Storm Resort”, designed to offer multi-day visitor experiences. The resort comprises with a boardroom, conference facilities, a multi-cuisine restaurant and recreation zones. …

India’s first integrated fun destination offering amusement cum water park, snow park, cable car and resort at a strategic tourist location On operationalization of ropeway cable car at our Athirappilly Theme Park, we are positioned to be the first fully integrated amusement destination in India, combining an amusement cum water theme park, indoor snow park, ropeway cable car, and resort accommodation within a single property. Our Athirappilly Theme Park is strategically located in midst of lush green forest area of western ghats in Thrissur district of Kerala and nearby scenic Athirappilly waterfalls, largest waterfall in Kerala and Vazhachal waterfalls, a prominent tourist destination in Kerala. The park is approximately 27 km from Cochin International Airport and about 20 km from Chalakudy Railway Station, with access to KSRTC and private bus terminals, making it a convenient daytrip destination for both local and outstation visitors. (Source: Care Report) Kerala’s first indoor snow park under the brand name “Snow Storm” in the year 2017, spread over approximately 10,000 square feet and maintained at -10°C (Source: Care Report). Snow Storm is a standalone attraction of our Athirappilly Theme Park with independent ticketing and features various snow-based experiences which are otherwise not naturally available in Kerala such as snowfall simulation, snow tubing, snow mat slide, snow dance rink, an igloo house, and themed play areas. Operating under a separate ticketing model, the Snow Storm provides an additional monetization layer and serves as a venue for private events, wedding shoots, and institutional gatherings, helping to maintain a stable footfall across weekdays and seasons. To complement its recreational portfolio, Silver Storm Resorts offers well-appointed, air-conditioned rooms that encourage extended visitor stays and higher average spending. The upcoming 1.2 km ropeway cable car, expected to be commissioned in second quarter of Fiscal 2027, will further elevate the park’s appeal by introducing a unique aerial transit experience with panoramic views of the western ghats, Chalakudy river and surrounding landscapes. The integrated model provides infrastructure and operational synergies across functions such as power, ticketing, security, and customer service, resulting in cost efficiencies and smoother management. Our Athirappilly Theme Park also draws from a vast urban catchment across Kerala and from nearby urban center of Tamil Nadu, including Coimbatore, Erode, Tirupur, Namakkal, Madurai, Dindigul, Karur, Nilgiris and Selam, representing a total catchment population of over 50 million people (source: Care Report). The visitor base spans families, educational institutions, corporate groups, and domestic tourists, with strong institutional bookings contributing significantly to footfall. The Company follows a multi-attraction approach to enhance visitor experience, improving average ticket value, and encouraging duration of stay. …

Expansion and upgradation of the existing attraction to enhance visitor experience and drive repeat footfalls With over 25 years of experience in the amusement and leisure industry, we have built a strong understanding of evolving visitor preferences and market trends. Leveraging this expertise, we continue to upgrade and expand our attractions to enhance visitor experience, increase engagement and drive repeat footfalls. For Fiscal 2026, Fiscal 2025, and Fiscal 2024 our total capital expenditure towards expansion and upgradation of the existing attraction was ₹ 6,360.79 lakhs, ₹ 2,441.28 lakhs, and ₹ 1,046.82 lakhs. As part of our 25th anniversary celebrations, we are planning to introduce 25 new amusement rides and high-thrill water slides. By October 2025, we have launched several new attractions including flying boat, chick run, spray ball, self-control plane, mini train, mini plane, bouncing cloud, park train, space shuttle, giraffe flying chair, mechanical bee, mechanical plane, and mini pirate ship, along with the upgradation of the kids’ pool to a family castle pool featuring new family-oriented slides. Further, we have placed orders for additional rides such as flying UFO, tagda, flying kite, sambha balloon, and tea cup. In addition, we are developing a 1.2 km ropeway cable car project at our Athirappilly Theme Park. Designed as a standalone ticketed attraction, the ropeway cable car will offer panoramic views of the lush green surroundings of western ghats, the Chalakudy river, and surrounding landscapes, appealing to new visitor segments such as ecotourists and families seeking immersive leisure experiences. Complementary infrastructure, including a themed forest village and ancillary attractions, is also planned to enrich the offering and generate additional non-ticket revenues. We have also developed a Central Plaza at the park entrance, comprising a restaurant, locker room, and ticket counter, improving visitor convenience and service quality. Recent installations like the caribbean bay aqua play station, boomerang slide, aqua loop, and kamikaze slide have received favourable visitor response, contributing to higher engagement and average revenue per footfall. We intend to expand in our existing park by utilizing a portion of the issue proceeds amounting to ₹ 1,513.70 lakhs for a new restaurant, banquet hall, and expansion of the existing snow park facility to further enhance guest experience. Together, these developments form part of our broader strategy of experience diversification, combining thrill-based, immersive, and scenic attractions to strengthen destination appeal, enhance ticket realizations, and promote repeat visitation across our park, snow, and resort facilities. For further details, please see “Objects of the Issue - Details of the Objects of this Issue - Funding capital expenditure in relation to the expansion and upgradation of our existing Park in Kerala Athirappilly Theme Park, Kerala” on page 126. …

Safety begins with regular training and assessment of our ride operators and attendants to prevent accidents.
Operators conduct scheduled inspections and report unsafe conditions to the maintenance team. Critical rides,
such as roller coasters, follow enhanced inspection protocols. Our amusement cum water park also employs 46
lifeguards during operational hours. To enhance security, parks are divided into internal and external perimeters
with controlled access points to monitor crowd movement and prevent trespassing. Zoning within the parks allows
for effective emergency response, evacuation, and resource deployment.

rows: Our operations at Athirappilly Theme Park and Snow Storm have major requirements for reliable access to power
and water resources. Power requirements for rides, filtration systems, lighting, sound systems and refrigeration
units are primarily met through the state electricity grid, with backup generators ensuring uninterrupted operations.
Water, a key resource for the amusement cum water park, is sourced from our internal underground boring
facilities and treated for reuse through efficient recycling systems of Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP). Our parks
adhere to prescribed environmental and safety standards while implementing energy-efficient and water
conservation measures to ensure sustainable operations.
tables.title: INFRASTRUCTURE UTILITIES

rows: We maintain an extensive and structured maintenance system designed to ensure operational safety, cleanliness,
and guest satisfaction across all rides, pools, and utility systems. The park’s maintenance framework is guided by
detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and daily checklists that cover dry rides, water rides, and the
Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP). Each ride undergoes a thorough inspection of structural, mechanical, electrical,
and safety components to prevent breakdowns and uphold safety standards. Dedicated teams of technicians,
supervisors and engineers ensure continuous monitoring and swift rectification of any issues, with attendance and
task records maintained daily for accountability and transparency.

A theme park is an amusement park centred around a specific theme or concept, such as a fantasy world, historical period, or popular movie franchise. These parks are designed to offer visitors a cohesive and immersive experience, with attractions, rides, entertainment, and architecture aligned with the park’s theme. Theme parks typically feature a variety of attractions, including roller coasters, live shows, interactive exhibits, and themed dining experiences. Popular examples include Disney World and Universal Studios. …

A water park is an amusement park that mainly features attractions based on water, such as water slides, wave pools, lazy rivers, and splash pads. These parks are designed to provide visitors with both relaxation and adventure through various water-based activities. Water parks can exist as standalone facilities or be part of a larger theme park. They are especially popular during hot weather, offering a fun way to cool off. This category primarily features Cable Cars and Snow Parks, which are gaining popularity as experiential attractions. Cable cars not only serve as a mode of transportation in hilly or elevated terrains but also offer panoramic sightseeing experiences, making them a major draw for tourists and leisure seekers. Snow parks, on the other hand, simulate winter environments and activities such as skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating, allowing visitors, especially in tropical regions, to enjoy snow-related recreation year-round. …
